name: Raspberry Jam
ingredients: INGREDIENTS Sugar, raspberry (45%) (raspberry, raspberry juice from concentrate), gelling agent (440), acidity regulators (330, 333).
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep refrigerated at 0-4°C.
note: The 45% figure was re-cropped at native resolution and confirmed against the front-of-pack '45% FRUIT' badge. ⚠️ The per-100 g protein and fat-total values are embossed gold on a red ground and sit at the edge of legibility even at native resolution: both read 0.6 g, but 0.5 g cannot be fully ruled out, and the per-serving column (0.1 g for each) does not disambiguate because 0.5 and 0.6 both round to 0.1 at a 10 g serving. Every other figure is crisp. pack.size 450 g is derived from 'Servings per package: 45' x 'Serving size: 10 g'; the net weight is not in either frame. The label declares no allergens. Front also claims 'NO ADDED COLOURS, FLAVOURS OR PRESERVATIVES'. No distributor address and no barcode in frame.
